drafts.title: Temperature
drafts.pitch: The user turns the room's temperature dial from 0 to 2.0 to "balanced," and only Cursor changes.
drafts.reason: The soup escalation and "The answer is 4, probably soup" land and Tilde as the unchanged constant is on-model, but the first three panels are mostly setup and "Balanced." is a mild button.

drafts.title: Waffles
drafts.pitch: The memory tool tells Cursor the user has a cat, and Cursor tries very hard to remember its name.
drafts.reason: "I knew it was a breakfast!" is a good Cursor line and "Close." a clean tag, but it is a single-note gag and the memory-tool premise is thinner than the best strips.
